scope: Source-only numerical diagram and icon verification: supplied English original base rules, publisher-linked original icon overview, and original base publisher Spielzene component photo. No summary, answer key, reader, strategy guide, BGA or community source used.

reputation_track.initial_source: English rules p. 5 C1 directs placement on first reputation space; English p. 2 and publisher component image label its first cell 1.

English rules p. 9 display example; parent-rendered main-p9-reputation-detail.png

bonuses.effect: Upgrade any 1 action card to side II.
Take 1 card within reputation range or draw 1 card from the deck.
bonuses.glyph: white card with deck stack and reputation cap

reputation_track.bonus_sources: English rules p. 2 printed symbols; original publisher photo clarifies small 1 numerals and cell positions; Icon Overview p. 1 decodes icons. English rules p. 9 says track bonuses occur immediately and only once.
reputation_track.space_10_requirement: Cards action must already be upgraded to side II to enter reputation 10 or higher. The space-10 Cards-II symbol is a requirement/reminder, not a bonus.
reputation_track.space_10_source: English rules p. 9, explicit prose and p. 2 diagram.
reputation_track.excess_reputation: Once at reputation 15, each additional reputation step gives 1 appeal instead; English rules p. 9.
reputation_track.card_reward_disambiguation: The reputation-13 deck-plus-cap symbol is the in-range/deck choice in Icon Overview p. 1. It is distinct from the beige overlapping-card snapping symbol below it.

map_A_printed_support_bonuses.ordering: Top to bottom on left edge of Map A, English rules p. 6.

top_four_purple_immediate_and_each_break.effect: Snap 1 card: take any 1 card from the display.
top_four_purple_immediate_and_each_break.note: Beige overlapping cards icon; no reputation-range restriction.
Normal placement requirements still apply; the icon specifies a 2-space standard enclosure.

map_A_printed_support_bonuses.sources: English rules p. 6 Map A left edge; Icon Overview p. 1 for exact glyph meanings and p. 2 for purple immediate-plus-income versus yellow immediate effect; rules p. 6 explains removing a map token when supporting a conservation project.

map_A_partner_zoo_positions.ordering: Bottom to top, printed positions 1 through 4 in English p. 6.
map_A_partner_zoo_positions.requirement: Position 3 and therefore position 4 require upgraded Association action, shown by upper pink region and Association-II condition icon; English rules p. 14 explicitly confirms third/fourth partner requirement.
map_A_partner_zoo_positions.cost_reduction: Each partner zoo reduces animal costs by 3 money per matching continent icon; English rules p. 7 and p. 14. The map prints -3 beside each partner position.
sources: English rules p. 6 Map A right edge
English rules p. 7 and p. 14 prose

map_A_university_positions.ordering: Bottom to top, printed positions 1 through 3 in English p. 7 continued Map A diagram.
map_A_university_positions.source: English rules p. 7 lower-left continued Map A diagram.

university_tile_exact_effects.source: English rules p. 14 Association board diagram, strength-4 section: three university silhouettes. Icon Overview p. 1 identifies research, reputation and hand-limit glyphs.
university_tile_exact_effects.distinction: The hand-limit-5 university has a reputation-1 cap icon, not a research icon. Its printed effects are hand limit 5 and 1 reputation only.

supplemental_photo.role: Original publisher base component photograph, used to read the matching original board numerals and symbols more clearly; no German revised prose rule is adopted.
